verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents a dedicated CI/CD experiments workflow for catching quality regressions and blocking deploys. Experiments can run programmatically through the SDK (`run_experiment`). It also offers a CLI for terminal and coding-agent use, SDK and API access to data and metrics, and Docker-based self-hosting that can run fully headless. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI/headless use, and detailed documentation of the CLI's command surface (only a one-line mention).
